manualProfileSetup.reason: The persisted demo profile had already run its service catalogue migration before the final four SGB V seed entries were added.
manualProfileSetup.method: Added through the real Leistungen > Neu UI/API flow in the synthetic demo profile.

steps: Opened Verwaltung > Leistungen and captured the catalog title, sidebar location, and active catalogue entries.
Added the four requested SGB V task entries through the real catalog flow; captured the task rows together with the inactive retained synthetic entry.
Renamed the assigned synthetic catalogue service from Große Grundpflege to Synthetische Grundpflege A.
Reopened Demo Pflegegrad Null without restarting the app, opened the compact service picker, and captured its collapsed summary and expanded top group with the selected services.
Saved the same patient with three selected services and reopened the patient detail. The current renamed label is shown, and the MD-Personenliste outcome is Auf der Liste with one explanatory reason.
observations: The catalog is headed Leistungen für betreute Personen and is clearly separated from team Kompetenzen in the sidebar.
The SGB V catalogue includes separate compression-stocking and medication preparation/administration tasks.
The inactive Synthetische §36 Kombi Pflege entry remains visible with deaktiviert and Aktivieren, preserving catalogue history.
The expanded picker shows Synthetische Grundpflege A and Kleine Grundpflege selected at the top of the § 36 group; the third selected service remains represented in the grouped summary.
After the assigned service was renamed, the reopened detail uses the current catalogue label while retaining the original label snapshot in storage; no duplicate MD-person-list reason is shown.
